attackers_goals: Exfiltrate data to a foreign account.
description: A cloud storage object was copied or moved to a foreign cloud storage account. The destination account was either not monitored or not seen within your tenant for the last 30 days.
detector_tags: Cloud Data Asset Exfiltration, Cloud Data Asset Configuration, Data Detection & Response
investigative_actions: Check the legitimacy of the copy operation. Review further actions performed by the identity.
name: A cloud storage object was copied to a foreign cloud account
